address: 807 Gervais St., Ste. 100, Columbia, SC, 29201, USA
bio: Exposed brick walls and tile floors hint at the building's former incarnation as a Ford dealership but this address has been home to Di Vino Rosso for more than two decades. This longstanding Italian restaurant is a Columbia favorite, known for its focused menu of Italian staples made with local ingredients (they even list their farmers on the back of the menu). Tuck into a bowl of meatballs resting in tomato sauce before a plate of pappardelle with a rich and flavorful wild boat and Italian sausage Bolognese sauce. While the savory dishes are certainly the highlight, end the meal with an espresso and tiramisu for a classic finish. ---...
